units.source_text: “那是……”千重子不知该不该说，可是还是说了，

en.t: “That was...” Chieko did not know whether she should say it, but she said it anyway,

units.source_text: “过节那天晚上，在四条大桥上，秀男先生答应给她织腰带的那个姑娘，其实不是我，你认错人了。”

en.t: “That girl on Shijo Bridge on the night of the festival, the one Mr. Hideo promised to weave an obi for, was not actually me. You mistook me for someone else.”
